title: The Place Where Argument Becomes Demand

features.name: the insistent angle
features.desc-on-touch: The slope reaches its sharpest point. You feel the downward pull as physics, then as pressure, then as argument made manifest in land itself.

features.name: roots bracing downslope
features.desc-on-touch: Tree roots written into soil in desperate grip-patterns. They argue back against the demand, but you can see where they are losing.

features.name: the stone that slid
features.desc-on-touch: A boulder halfway down the drop, caught mid-argument. The slope has won. The stone is still settling into its new certainty.

features.name: the gradient made legible
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph marking the exact angle where argument becomes physical law. The number itself is the demand.

features.name: clay loosened
features.desc-on-touch: Soil rendered unstable, ready to move. The argument has won the soil's compliance. Everything here is one footstep from descent.

features.name: the path downward
features.desc-on-touch: Already worn. Already taken many times. The slope has made its demand so often that the land remembers the answer.

inscription: down is no longer a suggestion

file.name: Slope_Incidence_Angle_Acoustic_Study_Seasonal_Recording.mp3
file.note: Spring heard the slope still arguing. Summer heard it insisting. Autumn heard it demand. Winter heard nothing but the answer.

exits.label: back up the slope where the argument still echoes
to the ridge above where things still believe in level ground
toward the streambed where water complies without debate
into the forest where trees still argue with the slope
